change: Primary sound-horizon method becomes an exact Boltzmann-code r_d (CAMB 2.0.4, cross-checked with CLASS 3.3.4) instead of the analytic fitting formula. The preregistered fitting-formula analysis is retained and reported as the secondary analysis.
reason: CAMB/CLASS/cobaya were not installed when the preregistration was written (15:54Z). They were installed at ~16:00Z in /mnt/disks/disk-socrateai-local-1/venv-cosmo. Positive control on Planck 2018 best-fit parameters: CAMB rdrag = 147.1027 Mpc, CLASS rs_drag = 147.0971 Mpc (published Planck 2018: 147.09 +- 0.26). The fitting formula's stated accuracy is comparable to the 0.26-sigma tolerance, so it would dominate the error budget; the exact code removes that systematic.
disclosure: A first fit output from the fitting-formula method already existed when this amendment was made (fit.json, written 16:03:03Z by the fit agent). The amender did NOT read its contents. It was hash-locked and renamed unread: fit_attempt1_fittingformula_UNREAD_AT_AMENDMENT.json, sha256 b7fe5608e4ae6d0b1cb0f7844e55a6025089336cc9bcb3086e9ead6e85531910. Both it and the amended result must be reported in the paper, whichever agrees better with the target.
success_rule: Unchanged from the preregistration; applied to the amended primary analysis, with the secondary (fitting-formula) outcome also reported.
